metodologia.title: Methodology
metodologia.subtitle: Every number on the site is computed by the tables published on this page — the same tables the engine executes. There is no second source of truth.
metodologia.p1: Nothing is invented. When a source fails, the datum shows as unavailable — never as a disguised estimate.
metodologia.p2: Weights and thresholds are heuristic and arbitrary. They encode operator judgement, not a calibrated model — published so they can be challenged.
metodologia.p3: Gaps are declared. What is missing contributes zero and lowers a reading's confidence in proportion to its weight.
metodologia.regimeIntro: The 0–100 score sums stress points from {count} signals. A missing signal adds zero and is recorded as a gap in the audit trail.
metodologia.weirdIntro: If any of these conditions holds and the score reaches {weirdMin}, the posture becomes «mixed».
metodologia.directionIntro: Where the market is heading — scale −100 to +100.
metodologia.riskIntro: Fragility to a cascade — scale 0 to 100, higher is worse.
metodologia.moneyIntro: Whether new money is entering the system — scale −100 to +100.
metodologia.gapNote: A missing ingredient contributes zero and is listed as a gap; a reading's confidence is the fraction of total weight actually covered.
